svg.title: Page thumbnails form the story ribbon
svg.desc: Arrange recurring scene motifs as a continuous manuscript ribbon ending in continuation. Preserve provenance tabs so compression into thumbnails does not erase sourcing.

**Location:** `curt-home-office`

**Frame:** Page thumbnails form a continuous ribbon: shared state, erasure, inheritance, breach, investigation, remediation, continuation.

**Action:** Provenance tabs remain visible beneath every thumbnail rather than falling away during assembly.

**Font:** `explanation`

**Caption:**
> THE APPARATUS IS PART OF THE STORY.
> THE SOURCE LABELS, DISPUTES AND OMITTED CONNECTIONS ARE PART OF WHAT THE MANUSCRIPT TELLS ITS READER. REMOVING THEM WOULD CHANGE THE STORY’S CLAIMS EVEN IF THE ORDER OF EVENTS STAYED THE SAME.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `inferred` — manuscript state and project principle.
